name: ipatool
description: Command-line tool that allows searching and downloading app packages (known as ipa files) for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS from the App Store.
one_liner: A command-line tool for downloading iOS app installer files (.ipa) directly from the App Store.
buyer: A mobile QA or security team that needs to pull specific historical app builds for testing or malware analysis without going through Xcode.
business_use_cases: A mobile security firm automates ipa retrieval for static-analysis pipelines.
An enterprise IT team builds internal app archiving for compliance and version rollback.
A QA shop grabs a specific prior app version to reliably reproduce a reported bug.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it in a simple internal web UI and sell it as an app-archiving tool to enterprise mobile teams.

steal_this: Put a small web front-end over it as an internal 'grab any past build of our own app' tool, and offer it to mobile QA teams as a lightweight paid utility.
